# Data retention policy

## 4. Retention periods

4.1 Customer account data is kept while the account is open and for 2 years after it closes, for disputes and refunds.

4.2 When the 2 years have passed, a closed account is deleted from live systems within 30 days, and from backups when those backups expire.

4.3 Payment records are kept for 7 years, as tax law requires.

## 5. Review

5.1 This policy is reviewed every year by the DPO.
